recipes.name: Spaghetti Tacos inspired by iCarly
ingredients: 2 tsp dried Oregano, divided in half
instructions: For your sauce, add olive oil to a deep saute pan along with minced onion. Cook until soft and translucent before adding red pepper flakes and dried oregano, cloves of chopped garlic, and tomato paste. Mix to combine. - 2 tbsp Olive Oil - ½ small Onion minced - 1 tsp Red Pepper Flakes - 1 tsp dried Oregano divided in half - 4 cloves Garlic chopped - 4 tbsp Tomato Paste

In a food processor, add your San Marzano tomatoes and pulse 5 times before adding to your pan. Add your chopped basil turn to medium low and let cook for an hour stirring every 10 minutes - 1 can San Marzano Tomatoes - Basil chopped

For your meatballs, combine ground beef with egg, panko bread crumbs, garlic powder, milk, and oregano. Mix with your hands to combine and then roll into 1 inch balls. Toss them in the rest of the breadcrumbs. - 1 pound Ground Beef - 1 Egg - ½ cup Panko Bread Crumbs divided - 1 tsp Garlic Powder - 1 tsp Milk - 1 tsp dried Oregano divided in half
In a large pot, bring vegetable oil to 350°F and then add your meatballs. Cook for 3-5 minutes. Once cooked, remove and place on a wire rack over a rimmed baking sheet. - 1 quart Vegetable Oil
Cook your spaghetti until it’s almost done, reserving ¼ cup of the pasta water. - 1 box Spaghetti

In a saute pan add some of the sauce along with the pasta and ¼ cup of pasta water. Mix to combine and add butter along with some salt and a good glug of olive oil. Mix or toss to combine - 2 tbsp Butter - Olive Oil - Salt

In a non stick pan add shredded parmesan cheese. Let it melt until the edges are starting to brown and then flip and cook for another 2 minutes. Remove from pan and place over a rolling pin and let it cool and harden. Once hardened add some pasta and sauce to it with your meatballs and top with some parmesan cheese. - 2 ounces Parmesan Cheese shredded
